note: What may flow in the Cell view of a species, and on what basis each direction is drawn (rules 3, 7, 11 and 12, and the section "Flux in the Cell view"). A species' cell has one source at a time: its own looping run, or, where it has none, illustration. The two never share a picture. Every direction drawn names its basis: a run's own signs, or a law of the engine cited here by its id and where it was read. Where neither gives a direction, both ways are drawn and none is claimed, or nothing is drawn and the reason is given.
colours: A bead of sodium or of potassium wears that ion's own colour (data/layers/ions.json, rule 8). Every other bead wears the one neutral tone of that file: only three colours were validated together, so no hue of the cell picture stands beside them.

engine.says: Each law cited here was read in the engine's source at this revision. The viewer keeps the words and does not read the engine: when a law changes, this file is brought up to date by hand.

direction only.says: Direction only: the number of beads and their pace stand for no number

typical values.says: Typical values from a cited source, not from a run
typical values.needs: Each number needs a source whose licence allows the number to be kept here. None is entered yet, so this form is not offered.

illustration.speaks_for: A law of the engine speaks for the engine's generic cell. It is drawn on a species only where the page shows that species as the generic cell, or as modelled, and the species' file has no words of its own on the part. For a species that is only proposed nothing is in the engine, and where a species' file says how its own part differs, the engine's law claims nothing about it.

sodium-potassium pump.declares: SODIUM_PER_CYCLE = -3 and POTASSIUM_PER_CYCLE = 2, counted positive into the cell ("3 Na out / 2 K in")
sodium-potassium pump.limit: The law's cycles are signed. The direction drawn is that of a forward cycle, which spends fuel; whether a pump runs forward at a given moment is a run's to say.

calcium pump.declares: CALCIUM_PER_CYCLE = -1, counted positive into the cell ("Positive cycles move one divalent Ca from the cytosol to the outside")
calcium pump.limit: The law's cycles are signed. The direction drawn is that of a forward cycle, which spends fuel; whether a pump runs forward at a given moment is a run's to say.

exchange routes.declares: DIRECTIONS = ("export", "import"): "export (secretion, cell to node) or import (uptake, node to cell)"
exchange routes.limit: Which routes a cell has, and how much each carries, is a world's declaration and a run's result.

groups.label: Ions
groups.says: Both ways are drawn, and neither is claimed to carry more. Which way more ions go through a channel depends on the cell's voltage and on the concentrations on its two sides, which only a run knows.

groups.label: Sodium–potassium pump
groups.says: One forward cycle of the sodium–potassium pump carries 3 sodium out of the cell and 2 potassium in. The two lanes show as many beads as each other: the three and the two stand here in words.

groups.label: Calcium pump
groups.says: One forward cycle of the plasma-membrane calcium pump carries 1 calcium out of the cell. Which of the pumps drawn stands for it is the picture's choice.

groups.label: Ions
groups.says: Both ways are drawn, and neither is claimed to carry more. Which way more ions go through a junction depends on the voltages and the concentrations of the two cells it joins, which only a run knows.

groups.label: Water
groups.says: Both ways are drawn, and neither is claimed to carry more. Water follows osmotic pressure: which way more of it goes depends on what is dissolved on the two sides of the membrane, which only a run knows.

groups.label: Signals
groups.says: An export route carries a molecule out of the cell and an import route carries one into it. Which routes a cell has, and how much each carries, only a run says: neither lane is claimed to carry more.
groups.unclaimed: Both ways are drawn, and neither is claimed to carry more: no law of the engine speaks for what this species releases and takes up.

kinds.label: Fuel (ATP)
kinds.nothing: Nothing is drawn for fuel. In the engine fuel is an amount that the pumps draw on where they stand; no law of the engine says where fuel travels in the cell, so a moving bead would claim a path that no law has.
